BREAKING: Bangladesh has approved Starlink's proposal to export internet bandwidth to neighboring countries. 🇧🇩

• Bangladesh approved Starlink’s bandwidth export proposal.
• Initial capacity is set at 40 Gbps with plans to scale up to 400 Gbps.
• The bandwidth is expected to be delivered through BSCCL.
• The move could position Bangladesh as a regional connectivity hub for Starlink.

Another step forward as Starlink continues expanding its global network.

The United States and SpaceX is leading the world in orbital launches by a wide margin. 🇺🇸

The United States has completed more orbital launches this year than China, Russia, Europe, Japan and India combined.

SpaceX is driving most of that momentum with its rapid launch cadence and reusable Falcon 9 rockets.

What once seemed impossible is now becoming routine.

Grok 4.5 is now in private beta at Tesla and SpaceX. 🤖

Powered by the new 1.5 trillion-parameter V9 model, Elon Musk says early performance is "close to, perhaps exceeding Opus."

xAI also plans to release a brand-new foundation model every month for the rest of 2026, pushing AI development at an unprecedented pace.

Tesla is now the #1 imported vehicle brand in Taiwan. 🇹🇼

With 4,369 new registrations in June, Tesla overtook Toyota and captured roughly 75% of Taiwan's EV market, led by strong demand for the Model Y and Model 3.

Another milestone for Tesla's global growth.

BREAKING: Qatar Airways has now connected **over 14 million passengers** with Starlink Wi-Fi. ✈️

Starlink is now active on more than **140 aircraft**, including the Boeing 777, Airbus A350 and Boeing 787, giving Qatar Airways the world's largest Starlink-equipped widebody fleet.

Passengers can enjoy free gate-to-gate internet where available with speeds that make streaming, video calls and work in the air feel like being on the ground.

Starlink is redefining what inflight connectivity should be.
